## Scope

Independent ordinary WI-1082 at fixed main base `00461714bd43d3f6c42ede66491e01d22d475604`. This draft contains only the approved two test surfaces and Runtime evidence. WI-1081 and its archive are untouched.

- Tighten complete field boundaries for stable cwd EACCES, including exact numeric errno and phase, UID, process identity and message.
- Recognize the supplied fd-directory EACCES / unknown-after Uncategorized ESRCH diagnostic envelope; preserve all Unknown/Retained, incomplete-evidence and no-cleanup assertions.
- Add a private-hook no-supervisor-receipt ESRCH diagnostic replay proving actual spawn exit 0 still aggregates to Unknown/Retained and persists the same JSON.
- Add a deterministic formatter control: deleting only fixture stat yields ENOENT/NotFound. It is not a kernel ESRCH reproduction and ENOENT remains rejected by the classifier.

No production observer, permission, cleanup, platform guard, public test-support or dependency changes.

## Evidence

Contract: `sha256:6f9a14a83c7a5c8963f5e978b9949a3a8d4907ee4e5d605ef938b4f15ee246dd`.

Original CI: run `38594384692`, artifact `11910505547`, log SHA-256 `38db1d4402376ca1bc4eab89dd4e2c7cd15c83950a4183f53f1ff25e2d01dec6`.

- RED source `fb85580d590b3fd68b27ec648dd0b87d701aa1fa`: old cwd positive tests 2/2 pass; fd replay, errno130 rejection and cwd-extra rejection fail exactly as expected. Both production controls remain GREEN 2/2.
- GREEN source `d0bfea33722eb6e14127c7523cfa87f5f318a046`: strict matrix 8/8, private controls 2/2, original failed integration 1/1 pass through Runtime.
- Full `cargo test --workspace --all-targets` formal verification passed on source commit `9d7408cae78647a325d77e64cff6ac960cc4d8b1`: 13/13 nodes actually spawned, 0 reuse, all exit 0, no timeouts or spawn failures. Host 643.42 seconds < 900; Runtime elapsed 639514 ms. Receipt digest `sha256:25c338cb3c42976e3c719b124fb277622f758e317a76a20c393523acc2ee6e3b`; raw receipt SHA-256 `5a14710d5c381ea4e515982cd4d6e764e59a55d5c2e3ce559417cd34cb5e0ec2`. Full 13-member coverage manifest and execution records independently checked. Repository stdout is bounded/truncated, with the flag preserved.
- Full receipt and diagnostics are published at `4890bb3a1eb47b3d0463328eb8c8d57e7ba6cd92`; latest-head CI run [38653477624](https://github.com/xinglun/ai-cockpit/actions/runs/38653477624) completed successfully: route, quality, windows-runtime, and v1-behavioral-oracle all succeeded. Quality job logs confirm 40 passed + 2 not_applicable; Windows repository library reports 102 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored. Windows verification unit/execution/composition invocations report 24/27/24 passed. CI tested the synthetic PR merge `8c9ae7d62a59ca197fbc3643d0a7d8f9711c680d`, with PR head `4890bb3a1eb47b3d0463328eb8c8d57e7ba6cd92` and base `00461714bd43d3f6c42ede66491e01d22d475604`. Counts were read from official GitHub job logs; local artifact ZIP download returned 403. Source snapshot remains `sha256:5717b916bda06e4c6163e0a5f6c25d78cb0c021ddb2041079d08f9bdad834b8c`.
- Historical Runtime status at reviewed source head `4890bb3a` (before technical archive): checkpointed, verification verified/fresh, blockers []; `user_visible_benefit_not_declared` remains explicit. Technical finish/archive are recorded below; human close remains unrecorded.

Logs and exact Runtime receipts: `.ai/evidence/WI-1082-procfs-fail-closed-test-envelope.20261014/`.

Isolated target; one Cargo build job; host cap 900 seconds; writable HOME/TMPDIR; no independent procfs monitors during fixtures. This PR remains draft; no merge, deletion, cleanup or human close is authorized here.


## Technical archive checkpoint

Raydot independently reviewed and technically accepted exact source head `4890bb3a1eb47b3d0463328eb8c8d57e7ba6cd92` with no P1/P2 findings. Fresh Runtime admission then allowed finish and archive; both actual commands returned exit 0.

- Archive checkpoint: `f734a678483fb8cc6f4152238605d724d7368113` (governance/evidence only; production and test source unchanged).
- Archive identity / manifest SHA-256: `85f318f95a368da608186f4cac86069ed8e7bc0b75d38e75a5568070e0dad1d4`. Remote manifest bytes were read back and matched local.
- Contract canonical digest remains `sha256:6f9a14a83c7a5c8963f5e978b9949a3a8d4907ee4e5d605ef938b4f15ee246dd`; archived Contract raw SHA-256 is `42adbb37bd5c4c4789bb544ea3d8a82d11cb616cf76aeb525f77f1fa6ad006f1`.
- Formal verification receipt and snapshot bindings are unchanged and fresh.
- Runtime lifecycle is archived with `archived_work_item_pending_close`; `user_visible_benefit_not_declared` is preserved. No human close, merge, deletion or cleanup was executed. Host display confirmation remains unknown.
- Exact finish/archive commands, outputs, technical review source, and byte manifest are retained in `.ai/evidence/WI-1082-procfs-fail-closed-test-envelope.technical-archive-20261014/`.
- Source head CI `38653477624` is the earlier all-green run. Final archive-checkpoint CI [38656756556](https://github.com/xinglun/ai-cockpit/actions/runs/38656756556) succeeded: 4/4 jobs (route, quality, windows-runtime, v1-behavioral-oracle). Official quality logs confirm 40 passed + 2 not_applicable. Official Windows logs confirm receipt_store 9/9 and repository library 102/102, all with zero failures/ignored tests. The tested synthetic PR merge was `e009cb544508b45069197ae723eaa4da69776125`, bound to archive head `f734a678483fb8cc6f4152238605d724d7368113` and base `00461714bd43d3f6c42ede66491e01d22d475604`.


## Ray-authorized human close checkpoint

Ray personally approved the exact WI-1082 archive/Contract close, PR1038 merge after final CI/review, and normal exact WI-1082 cleanup at `2026-10-15T00:43:34Z` (transcript `Sentinel_09ad7190a7a4819181c67b10a431cf53`; request `Sentinel_9ffe74113e8c8191a76907389e445bb7`). Runtime close actually returned exit 0 and recorded actor `human:Ray` with that authority source and decision time.

- Close recovery head: `8633e9ac9191434e2e261d974c35a4db07bba2f2`; source code and archive bytes are unchanged. Remote close-record bytes matched local.
- Fresh Runtime status is closed / verification verified, blockers []; `user_visible_benefit_not_declared` remains explicit. Prior yellow archive Outcome above is historical.
- Original commands, authority transcript binding, outputs and byte manifest: `.ai/evidence/WI-1082-procfs-fail-closed-test-envelope.human-close-20261015/`.
- Final close-head CI and Raydot verification are pending. Merge/cleanup have not run yet; no authorization is implied for WI-1081, WI-1078 or the mistaken ref.
